_about: The models the app can download (#383): one pin, read by the app (ml_pipeline::Catalog::built_in, included at build time) and by crates/ml-pipeline/tests/model_manifest.rs. A model is only ever downloaded when the user presses Download in Settings. `repo` and `revision` name a Hugging Face repository and the commit to fetch, never a branch, so a file cannot change under a pin; each file's `url` must be https://huggingface.co/<repo>/resolve/<revision>/<path> (the test checks it), and `size` and `sha256` are checked while the file is written and again before it is renamed into place. `license` is the SPDX id of the model the export was made from. whisper-base: the table on #384, every file downloaded and hashed on 2026-10-22. The transcribe tool runs this model (#384); it finds the files with ml_pipeline::models::cached and never downloads.
